name: repair-keys
note: B32 findings: the repair list's key route on wj-ia-300's session fixture. Name cap 150, then jumble.repair.focus in the palette opens Local's Repair list and gives it the keys (no click); Down twice focuses row 2, the digit 2 stages it, and jumble.repair.stage 1 in the palette stages row 1. No row is focused on open and nothing is staged before a digit or Enter.
